theorem.familywise_reassembly: O1 replaces each local nonlinear root w_j by w_0; O2 supplies every mismatched E_j--b_l pair; O3 transports DM_0[a_j] to DM_j[a_j] and does not cancel the R-071 linear term. Exactly L+D+O=<w_0,Q(M_T-M_0)^T C>.
theorem.raw_current_telescope: With the R-069 mixed, control, and raw Gaussian polarizations retained, L+N_G+D+O+|Delta w+c_T|_Q^2/2=sum_j(R_j^{G,raw}+R_j^x+R_j^C)-S_G-S_C. The finite-low boundary survives Wick conversion.
theorem.projector_free_completion: For P_mix=<w_0,QE_tot^T C>+<Delta w,Qc_T>+|c_T|_Q^2/2, restoring S_C and L gives S_C+L+P_mix=<w_T,Qc_T>+|c_T|_Q^2/2, and adding |w_T|_Q^2/2 gives |w_T+c_T|_Q^2/2 on every rank stratum without a pseudoinverse.
theorem.phase_kernel: The explicit terminal kernel projector has ranks 2, 3, and 6 on the generic, s=0, and u=0 strata. After S_C and L are separated, its square-invisible component is nonzero; for every C in the terminal kernel, restoring both first variations gives S_C+L+<w_0,QE_tot^T C>=0 exactly.
theorem.explicit_phase_vector: With ell_r=Dq_r(z)[A], epsilon_r=q_r(z+A)-q_r(z)-ell_r, and beta_r=e_2^TQw_{r,0}, the nonlinear vector is k=-2[(sum beta_r epsilon_r)(z+A)+(sum beta_r ell_r)A]. The R-071 fixture has nonlinear, linear, and base slopes 0.0674999999999706, 0.0108750000000198, and -0.0783749999999904, whose sum is zero.
theorem.absolute_route_boundary: In the declared raw termwise absolute largest-shell architecture, value-high O2 needs theta>1/4 for decay and theta<1/4 for random slack; value-high O3 needs theta>1/2 and theta<1/2. Both endpoints have deterministic budget exponent one and zero dyadic decay.
theorem.positive_gain_discriminator: An adapted root improving H^{-1/2-delta} by gamma derivatives has rho=gamma-delta. This route opens only for rho>0 and requires moments strictly above 3/rho after endpoint losses. R-063 does not supply the required adapted two-control theorem.

successor: Prove either a signed strict-past terminal phase-root coercivity theorem exploiting the exact restored completion while retaining the range square and finite-low boundary, or an adapted positive-gain root with rho>0 and p>3/rho for the two value-high branches. Then perform finite-energy extension, controlled-shell one-use, and q=10/9 Nelson synthesis.
honesty_boundary: This scoped T4 continuation proves exact familywise off-diagonal reassembly, the full raw current-telescope identity, projector-free restoration on every production-frame rank stratum, exact phase-kernel cancellation after both separated first variations are restored, and the endpoint conflict of the narrowly declared raw termwise absolute value-high Carleson route. It does not prove a cutoff-uniform stochastic terminal lower bound, an adapted positive-gain root, arbitrary finite-energy drift extension, controlled-shell one-use, the q=10/9 Nelson theorem, an interacting measure, floor or regulator removal, infinite volume, or T5--T7.
